shown_card_text.title: A terminal ticks through its steps
shown_card_text.what: A dark terminal lists plan, write tests, run tests, open a pull request and wait for review, and each line lights up in turn. The glow is green, not your locked blue.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more reusable Higgsfield shots, and each one needs your verdict.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Maybe an edit to recolour the glow blue; the pacing is good.
context: Made with your ten dollar top up, inside your thirty dollar month.
